message: Tool input is used as a file path in load_workbook with no check that the resolved path stays inside an allowed folder. Inputs like '../../.ssh/id_rsa' or absolute paths reach any file the server can read.
fix: In get_excel_path: reject absolute paths when EXCEL_FILES_PATH is set, resolve with Path(EXCEL_FILES_PATH, filename).resolve() and require .is_relative_to(Path(EXCEL_FILES_PATH).resolve()); also enforce an .xlsx/.xlsm extension.
reason: get_excel_path returns absolute paths unchanged and joins relative ones without resolving or checking containment, so in SSE/HTTP mode filepath='/home/user/finance.xlsx' or '../../secret.xlsx' escapes EXCEL_FILES_PATH. The same helper feeds every tool (read_data_from_excel, get_workbook_metadata, etc.), so any workbook on the host can be read.

title: create_workbook / write tools create or overwrite files at any path
reason: create_workbook takes any absolute or '../' path (same unchecked get_excel_path), creates missing directories and saves a workbook there without checking whether a file exists, so a caller can overwrite any file the server user can write (e.g. ~/.bashrc, config files) and create directories anywhere.
fix: Use the contained-path check from F001 for every tool, refuse to overwrite existing files in create_workbook (open with mode 'xb' or check exists()), and only allow .xlsx extensions.

title: HTTP/SSE server binds 0.0.0.0 with no authentication
reason: In sse/streamable-http mode the server listens on all interfaces by default and FastMCP is created with no auth, so anyone who can reach port 8017 can call every tool, and with F001/M001 read or overwrite files anywhere on the host.
fix: Default FASTMCP_HOST to 127.0.0.1, require a bearer token (FastMCP auth settings or a reverse proxy with auth) before exposing it, and enable Host/Origin checks.

title: Spreadsheet cell contents returned unmarked to the model
reason: Cell values from workbooks (often received from third parties) go straight into the model context; injected instructions in a cell can steer the destructive tools of this server (delete/overwrite). The server itself has no network egress, so impact is limited.
fix: Mark returned cell data as untrusted content and keep human approval on the destructive tools.
